label: manifests as
definition: A relation that holds between a physiological or molecular state of a microorganism and the observable phenotype it produces; asserts that the subject state is operationally realized in the object trait class.
traits_addressed: covers 52 causal-graph edges across trophic, salinity, pH, and temperature phenotype groupings
observations: paraphrase of `realized in`; preferred over RO:0002488 because the typical object is a TraitMech-internal trait class rather than an OBO-style realizable

label: selects for
definition: A relation that holds between an environmental condition and an adapted trait; asserts that prolonged exposure to the subject condition produces selective pressure favoring organisms expressing the object trait.
traits_addressed: covers 20 causal-graph edges across nutrient, pH, salinity, and temperature adaptation contexts
observations: no clean RO/Biolink home; biolink:related_to is too weak and biolink:causes is too strong (selection is evolutionary, not mechanistic)

label: feeds electrons into
definition: A relation that holds between an electron-donor entity and an electron-transport or respiratory pathway; asserts that the subject contributes reducing equivalents to the object pathway as part of its operation.
traits_addressed: covers 12 causal-graph edges in lithotrophic and respiratory metabolism graphs
observations: specialization of biolink:contributes_to applicable to redox cofactor / cytochrome flux specifically; preferred when the connection is electron-current rather than catalytic-input

label: transfers electrons to
definition: A relation that holds between an electron donor and an electron acceptor in a single redox step; asserts that the subject directly reduces the object.
traits_addressed: covers 6 causal-graph edges in cable-bacteria, respiration, and electron-transfer trait graphs
observations: sister-of feeds-electrons-into (METPO:2007402); the latter terminates in a pathway, this terminates in a single acceptor species

label: fixed by
definition: A relation that holds between an inorganic carbon (or other inorganic) substrate and a fixation pathway; asserts that the subject is converted to organic form by the object pathway.
traits_addressed: covers 9 causal-graph edges across autotrophic, chemoautotrophic, and photoautotrophic trait graphs
observations: inverse-of-style relation; biolink:produces is the wrong direction (substrate is acted upon, not produced)

label: oxidized to
definition: A relation that holds between a reduced chemical substrate and the oxidized product of a single net oxidation step.
traits_addressed: covers 8 causal-graph edges across chemoautotrophic, methylotrophic, and disproportionation trait graphs
observations: chemistry-of-process relation; no biolink slot captures the substrate→product direction with redox semantics

label: challenges
definition: A relation that holds between an environmental stressor and a tolerance trait or homeostatic mechanism; asserts that the subject creates the physiological perturbation that the object resists or buffers.
traits_addressed: covers 9 causal-graph edges across acidotolerance, alkalotolerance, halotolerance, and thermotolerance trait graphs
observations: paired-negative-of `mitigates` (METPO:2007407); pair is unidirectional (stressor → trait) and explicitly NOT a generic biolink:related_to

label: mitigates
definition: A relation that holds between a defense or homeostatic mechanism and a stressor or its physiological consequence; asserts that the subject reduces the damage or disruption the object would otherwise cause.
traits_addressed: covers 12 causal-graph edges across aerotolerance, osmotic, halophily, and oxidative-stress trait graphs
observations: paired-positive-of `challenges` (METPO:2007406); preferred over biolink:treats because that slot is clinical
